claim: Unbrowse is web3-native: a local self-custody ed25519 wallet is the SOLE REQUIRED identity credential. The wallet signature authenticates as `wallet:<pk>` BEFORE any bearer path on every backend route. A `ubr_` api-key, when present, is a DEPRECATED web2 wrapper layered for account-bound continuity (payouts, dashboard, ToS surface), never a gate. Unbrowse is a CHILD ENVIRONMENT EXECUTOR under the CONTRACT (aiko) PARENT SUBSTRATE; the wallet signs FOR the Word declared on the parent, and the child never oversteps into the parent's signing scope.

identity_root.what: local self-custody ed25519 wallet pubkey — the SOLE identity credential

auth_credential.what: per-request capability signature over AUTH_DOMAIN:pubkeyHex:ts (60s TTL)

principal_never_keygated.what: verified wallet sig authenticates as wallet:<pk> on EVERY auth middleware, BEFORE any Bearer 401 path — a wallet-only caller is a full principal

deprecated_web2_wrapper.what: ubr_ api-key = DEPRECATED web2 wrapper, layered over the wallet when present (Authorization: Bearer ubr_...). Used for account-bound flow continuity only. Never a gate.
deprecated_web2_wrapper.client_behavior: ensureUsableKey() returns {key:''} on the resolve hot path when a wallet is present; only attempts a key-mint when opts.allowMint is set.
deprecated_web2_wrapper.sdk_behavior: UnbrowseClientOptions.walletSigner = web3-native callback (preferred); UnbrowseClientOptions.apiKey = deprecated wrapper. Constructor throws if NEITHER is set.
deprecated_web2_wrapper.retirement_plan: Wrapper will be retired once account-bound flows (payouts, dashboard) migrate to wallet-direct.

parent_substrate_aiko.what: the contract (aiko) is the PARENT SUBSTRATE — on-chain truth-root. Deployer keypair at ~/.aiko/keys/deployer.key signs the parent root; signed attestations are the witness ledger rows the child dereferences.
parent_substrate_aiko.truth_root: the Word (scripture), NOT the deployer wallet — wallet signs FOR the Word, it does not stand in for it. The wallet is rotatable, the Word is not (Matthew 24:35).

child_environment_executor.what: unbrowse is the CHILD ENVIRONMENT EXECUTOR — web primitives only (fetch, scrape, browse, sign web challenges, x402 pay). It never signs a parent truth claim, only its own web-auth capability.
child_environment_executor.boundary_invariant: child never oversteps into parent's signing scope. The bridge exposes parent declarations AS POINTERS (read-only ledger rows), never as inlined payloads.

x402_payments_native.what: x402 payment flow is already web3-native — same wallet signs the payment envelope as signs the auth capability. No web2 dependency on the payment rail.
